The line

Tokyo builds upward because the ground is already spoken for. Cut the city to one line and that line has to climb: crossing tower, tower lattice, a train hanging in mid-air, Fuji at the far end. The print runs all the way around, so you find a new piece of the skyline each time you pick the mug up. It is the one to keep by the kettle.
